articles.title: Sterling drops against firmer dollar as markets price in a hawkish Fed
articles.excerpt:

Despite recent hawkish expectations supporting the pound, crude oil prices are rising, which could be unfavorable. Britain's gross domestic product data is due soon, with growth expectations for the third quarter. Analysts remain skeptical about the Bank of England achieving inflation targets before 2030.
